bySpecies:Euphorbia ingens.raw: Propagate by seed sown at 15-18°C in early spring or stem cuttings in spring or early summer

bySpecies:Clivia miniata.raw: Propagate by seed at 16-21°C as soon as ripe or by division in late winter or early spring

bySpecies:Schefflera arboricola.raw: Propagate by seed, semi-ripe cuttings or air- layering

bySpecies:Heptapleurum arboricola.raw: Propagate by seed, semi-ripe cuttings or air- layering

bySpecies:Pachira aquatica.raw: Propagate by seed, semi-ripe cuttings or air- layering

bySpecies:Sparrmannia africana.raw: Propagate by seed or semi- hardwood cuttings

bySpecies:Cissus rhombifolia.raw: Propagate by hardwood or greenwood cuttings in summer

bySpecies:Lobelia erinus.raw: Propagate by seed sown at 13-18ºC in late winter

bySpecies:Hypoestes phyllostachya.raw: Propagate by seed, softwood cuttings in late spring, or semi-ripe cuttings in summer

bySpecies:Ledebouria socialis.raw: Propagate by seed or removing offsets

byGenus:Philodendron.raw: Propagate by stem-tip or leaf bud cuttings

byGenus:Epipremnum.raw: Propagate by leaf-bud, stem tip cuttings or by layering in spring or summer

byGenus:Zamioculcas.raw: Propagate by leaf cuttings, using single leaflets

byGenus:Spathiphyllum.raw: Propagate by division in winter or immediately after flowering

byGenus:Calathea.raw: Propagate by division of rhizomes in summer

byGenus:Goeppertia.raw: Propagate by division in late spring

byGenus:Maranta.raw: propagate by basal cuttings, division or seed

byGenus:Ficus.raw: Propagate by seed, leaf-bud or semi- hardwood cuttings

byGenus:Sansevieria.raw: Propagate by leaf cuttings or division

byGenus:Yucca.raw: Propagate by seed, sown in spring at 19-24°C. Flowers may need hand-pollination to set seed. Rooted suckers can be removed in spring or take root cuttings in winter

byGenus:Beaucarnea.raw: Propagate by seed sown at 18 to 21°C in spring or root offsets in spring

byGenus:Chlorophytum.raw: Propagate by seed, by division or root plantlets

byGenus:Chamaedorea.raw: Propagate by sowing seed in spring at 25°C

byGenus:Dypsis.raw: Propagate by seed sown at not less than 25°C

byGenus:Howea.raw: Propagate by seed sown at not less than 19°C

byGenus:Trachycarpus.raw: Propagate by seed or by removing and potting up suckers

byGenus:Nephrolepis.raw: Propagate by spores, sow spores at 21°C (70°F) as soon as ripe. Separate rooted runners in late winter or early spring

byGenus:Adiantum.raw: Propagate by sowing spores as soon as ripe at a minimum of 21°C, or propagate by division of the rhizomes in early spring

byGenus:Platycerium.raw: Sow spores when ripe or detach plantlets

byGenus:Echeveria.raw: Propagate by seed sown as soon as ripe or by root, stem or leaf cuttings in spring

byGenus:Crassula.raw: Propagate by seed sown as soon as ripe or by offsets or by root, stem or leaf cuttings in spring

byGenus:Sedum.raw: Propagate by seed sown at 15 -18°C in early spring, or propagate by division

byGenus:Haworthiopsis.raw: Sow seed at 21-24°C in spring, separate offsets or take leaf cuttings in spring and summer

byGenus:Kalanchoe.raw: Propagate by seed or offsets in spring

byGenus:Sempervivum.raw: Propagate by seed sown in spring, or root offsets in spring

byGenus:Gasteria.raw: Propagate by seed, separating offsets or leaf cuttings

byGenus:Agave.raw: Propagate by offsets taken in spring or autumn

byGenus:Aeonium.raw: Propagate by seed sown at 19-24°C in spring or by cuttings of rosettes kept at 18°C and barely moist until rooted

byGenus:Lithops.raw: Propagate by seed or offsets in spring

byGenus:Rhipsalis.raw: Propagate by seed, sown at 19-24°C, or by stem cuttings in spring or summer

byGenus:Mentha.raw: Propagate by seed or division in spring or autumn

byGenus:Thymus.raw: Propagate by seed, by division or plant rooted basal stem cuttings in spring

byGenus:Salvia.raw: Propagate by seed in containers in a cold frame in spring or by semi-ripe cuttings in summer

byGenus:Petroselinum.raw: Propagate by seed sown in situ, in succession from late spring through summer

byGenus:Ocimum.raw: Propagate by seed in gentle heat in spring under glass or indoors, or sow in-situ in summer. See sowing seeds indoors for further advice

byGenus:Solanum.raw: Propagate by seed. See sowing vegetable seeds or sowing seeds indoors for further advice

byGenus:Capsicum.raw: Propagate by seed. See sowing vegetable seeds or sowing seeds indoors for further advice

byGenus:Cucurbita.raw: Propagate by seed. See sowing vegetable seeds or sowing seeds indoors for further advice

byGenus:Cucumis.raw: Propagate by seed. See sowing vegetable seeds

byGenus:Fragaria.raw: Remove and transplant runners. Propagate by seed sow at 13-18°C in spring

byGenus:Lactuca.raw: Propagate by seed. See sowing vegetable seeds

byGenus:Citrus.raw: Propagate by semi-ripe cuttings in summer, or layer in early spring. Sow seed at 16°C in spring; seedlings do not come true to type

byGenus:Prunus.raw: Propagate by Chip budding or grafting , although softwood cuttings in early summer with bottom heat can be successful.

byGenus:Malus.raw: Propagate by Chip budding in late summer, or grafting in mid-winter. Plants grown from pips are unlikely to resemble the parent

byGenus:Vitis.raw: Propagate by hardwood cuttings in late autumn or winter, or by softwood cuttings or semi-ripe cuttings from late spring to midsummer or grafting onto Phylloxera resistant rootstocks

byGenus:Rubus.raw: Choose disease-free stock for propagation. Propagate by softwood cuttings or semi-ripe cuttings from spring to midsummer, hardwood cuttings in winter, root cuttings in autumn and winter, leaf bud cuttings in mid to late summer, division from autumn to early spring and layering from late summer to early spring

byGenus:Vaccinium.raw: Take 10-15cm (4-6in) softwood cuttings in late spring or semi-ripe cuttings in early summer

byGenus:Hydrangea.raw: Propagate by softwood cuttings in early summer or hardwood cuttings in winter

byGenus:Pelargonium.raw: Propagate from softwood cuttings from spring to autumn.

byGenus:Hosta.raw: Propagation by division in late summer or early spring

byGenus:Acer.raw: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

byGenus:Buxus.raw: Propagate from semi-ripe cuttings in summer

byGenus:Hedera.raw: Propagate by semi- hardwood cuttings in summer. Cuttings from adult growth will produce shrubby, non-climbing plants

byGenus:Hoya.raw: Propagate by semi- hardwood cuttings or by layering

byGenus:Peperomia.raw: Propagate by seed, softwood , leaf or bud cuttings

byGenus:Saintpaulia.raw: Propagate by leaf cuttings in summer

byGenus:Crocus.raw: Propagate by division of clumps, or by separating cormlets

byGenus:Tulipa.raw: Propagate by division , separating offsets in summer. See bulb propagation for more details

byGenus:Narcissus.raw: Propagate by removing offsets as the leaves fade in early summer

byGenus:Hyacinthus.raw: Propagate by division , separating offsets when dormant in summer

byGenus:Canna.raw: Propagate by seed (sown indoors) or propagate by division of rhizomes in spring

byGenus:Musa.raw: Propagate by seed or Divide established clumps

byGenus:Coffea.raw: Propagate by sowing fresh seed. Germination may be erratic

byGenus:Ceropegia.raw: Propagate by seed at 19-24°C (66-75°F) in early spring or propagate from stem bulbils. Alternatively take stem cuttings, 10-15cm (4-6in) long in early summer, root in a cactus compost at 22-25°C (72-77°F), and keep moist

byGenus:Nerium.raw: Propagate by seed, semi- hardwood cuttings or by air layering in spring

byGenus:Rhododendron.raw: Propagate by semi-ripe cuttings in late summer, or by grafting in winter

byGenus:Gardenia.raw: Propagate by seed, greenwood or semi- hardwood cuttings

byGenus:Bougainvillea.raw: Propagate by layering in early spring, or by semi-ripe cuttings in summer or hardwood cuttings with bottom heat in winter

byGenus:Fargesia.raw: Propagate by division or take cuttings of sections of young rhizomes in spring

byGenus:Acacia.raw: Propagate by seed or semi- hardwood cuttings

byGenus:Abutilon.raw: Propagate by seed in spring at 15°C to 18°C, or by softwood cuttings

byGenus:Ranunculus.raw: Propagate by seed sown as soon as ripe, or by division inspring or late summer

byGenus:Euphorbia.raw: Propagate by stem cuttings in early summer. Use a hormone rooting compound

byGenus:Abelia.raw: Propagate by softwood cuttings in early summer or semi- hardwood cuttings in late summer

byGenus:Quercus.raw: Propagate by seed, sown as soon as ripe, in a cold frame

byGenus:Lonicera.raw: Propagate by seed in summer, removing the berry flesh before sowing, or by semi- hardwood or hardwood cuttings

byGenus:Iris.raw: Propagate by dividing irises from midsummer to early autumn, plant immediately in flowering positions

byGenus:Allium.raw: Propagate by seed, bulbs or division

byGenus:Berberis.raw: Propagate by seed and semi- hardwood cuttings

byGenus:Picea.raw: Propagate by seed or by semi- hardwood cuttings

byGenus:Centaurea.raw: Propagate by seed sown in-situ in spring or autumn

byGenus:Epipactis.raw: Propagate by division in spring, ensuring each piece of rhizome has at least one growing point

byGenus:Salix.raw: Propagate by softwood cuttings in early summer or hardwood cuttings in winter

byGenus:Tilia.raw: Propagate by seed, stratified in containers outdoors in spring. See Propagate from seed (tree/shrub ) Propagate by Chip budding although care must be taken with the choice of rootstock

byGenus:Abelmoschus.raw: Propagate by seed. See sowing vegetable seeds

byGenus:Brachychiton.raw: Propagate by seed as soon as ripe with heat in a propagator, or semi-ripe cuttings in summer, or hardwood cuttings in early autumn with bottom heat in a propagator

byGenus:Alnus.raw: Propagate by seed or hardwood cuttings

byGenus:Corylus.raw: Propagate by seed, layering or stooling or removing rooted suckers

byGenus:Betula.raw: Propagate by seed, softwood cuttings or grafting

byGenus:Campanula.raw: Propagate by seed, division or take basal cuttings

byGenus:Clematis.raw: Root softwood cuttings in spring or semi-ripe cuttings in early summer. Propagate by layering in late winter or early spring

byGenus:Helleborus.raw: Propagate by seed in pots in a cold frame as soon as seed is ripe or propagate by division after flowering in early spring or late summer

byGenus:Delphinium.raw: Propagate by taking pencil-thick, basal, softwood cuttings in early spring

byGenus:Pyrus.raw: Propagate by grafting or budding onto a clonal rootstock for fruit . Fruit grown from pips will not normally resemble the parent

byGenus:Alchemilla.raw: Propagate by seed in pots in a cold frame in spring or by division in spring or autumn

byGenus:Aronia.raw: Propagate by softwood cuttings in early summer, propagate by suckers when plants are dormant and pot up

byGenus:Photinia.raw: Propagate by semi- hardwood cuttings in summer. Or propagate by seed sown in containers, in a cold frame in autumn

byGenus:Ligustrum.raw: Propagate by seed, semi- hardwood and hardwood cuttings

byGenus:Jasminum.raw: Propagate by semi-ripe cuttings in summer or by layering in autumn

byGenus:Syringa.raw: Propagate by softwood cuttings in summer

byGenus:Lathyrus.raw: Propagate by seed. Sow in a cold frame in early autumn, early spring or in-situ in mid-spring. See sowing seeds indoors for further advice

byGenus:Phaseolus.raw: Propagate by seed. See sowing vegetable seeds

byGenus:Lupinus.raw: Propagate by seed in early to mid-spring or by basal stem cuttings in mid to late spring

byGenus:Magnolia.raw: Propagate by softwood cuttings from late spring to early summer or semi-ripe cuttings from late summer to autumn

byGenus:Hypericum.raw: Propagate by seed, division or take softwood cuttings

byGenus:Achillea.raw: Propagate by seed or by division in the spring

byGenus:Echinops.raw: Propagate by seed sown in seed bed in mid spring. Propagate by division in spring or autumn or by root cuttings in winter

byGenus:Rudbeckia.raw: Propagate by seed sown with gentle heat in spring. Light is needed for germination. Harden off before planting out

byGenus:Helianthus.raw: Propagate by seed or division . Divide established clumps every 2-4 years to both increase plants and retain vigour. See sowing seeds indoors for further advice

byGenus:Cichorium.raw: Propagate by seed. See sowing vegetable seeds or sowing seeds indoors for further advice

byGenus:Artemisia.raw: Two varieties have different types of propagation. Propagate Russian tarragon by seed and French tarragon semi- hardwood cuttings in late summer.

byGenus:Echinacea.raw: Propagate by division in spring or autumn or by root cuttings from late autumn to early winter

byGenus:Aloe.raw: Propagate by seed as soon as ripe, or propagate by separating offsets in spring or early summer. Root offsets in cactus potting compost

byGenus:Hemerocallis.raw: Propagate by division in early spring or early autumn

byGenus:Dianthus.raw: Propagate by softwood cuttings of non-flowering shoots in summer

byGenus:Veronica.raw: Propagate by division in autumn or spring

byGenus:Digitalis.raw: Propagate by seed sown in-situ in late spring. Alternatively sow in seed trays in late spring and plant out to final position in late summer; deadhead flowers regularly if seed is not required

byGenus:Lilium.raw: Propagate by seed, sown, when ripe, in containers in a cold frame or separate offsets after the foliage dies down

byGenus:Asparagus.raw: Propagate by crowns. Although propagation by seed is possible, it is not advisable as seedlings take longer, and may not be male cultivars which produce better plants

byGenus:Muscari.raw: Propagate by seed, sown in autumn, in containers in a cold frame or separate offsets in summer

byGenus:Scilla.raw: Propagate by seed, sown in pots in a cold frame when ripe, keep shaded and do not allow to dry out. Alternatively remove offsets in summer. See bulb propagation

byGenus:Ornithogalum.raw: Propagate by seed. If sowing in pots, leave, undisturbed, for the first two years with the occasional feed of liquid fertiliser. After this, Divide the bulbs into two or three per pot, leaving to grow for another year before planting outside

byGenus:Teucrium.raw: Propagate by softwood cuttings in early summer, semi-ripe cuttings in midsummer, both with bottom heat

byGenus:Origanum.raw: Propagate by seed or by division in the autumn or spring

byGenus:Phlomis.raw: Propagate by softwood cuttings in summer or division in the spring. Propagate by seed in late spring under cover

byGenus:Lavandula.raw: Propagate by seed sown in a cold frame in spring, or by semi- hardwood cuttings in summer. See our video how to take lavender cuttings for more advice

byGenus:Populus.raw: Propagate from hardwood cuttings in winter or suckers in autumn or late winter

byGenus:Oenanthe.raw: Propagate by division in late spring

byGenus:Cupressus.raw: Propagate by seed or semi- hardwood cuttings

byGenus:Chamaecyparis.raw: Propagate by seed and semi- hardwood cuttings

byGenus:Ipomoea.raw: Propagate by seed. See sowing seeds indoors for further advice

byGenus:Convolvulus.raw: Propagate by seed, root softwood cuttings in late summer, or Divide in spring

byGenus:Larix.raw: Propagate by seed in containers in early spring, graft in winter, or root semi-ripe cuttings in summer under mist; cuttings are difficult to root

byGenus:Pilea.raw: Propagate by seed, by division or detatch rosettes in spring

byGenus:Ctenanthe.raw: Propagate by seed or by division in spring

byGenus:Phoenix.raw: Propagate by seed sown at 19 to 24°C in spring

byGenus:Sambucus.raw: Propagate by softwood or hardwood cuttings

byGenus:Viburnum.raw: Propagate by semi-ripe cuttings in summer

byGenus:Ilex.raw: Propagate by seed in a coldframe in autumn, or propagate by semi-ripe cuttings in late summer or early autumn or propagate by hardwood cuttings in January with bottom heat

byGenus:Morus.raw: Propagate by seed, by semi-ripe cuttings in summer, or by hardwood cuttings in autumn

byGenus:Hordeum.raw: Propagate by seed in situ in spring or autumn
